text:
maya: hey folks — i'm maya (joined platform team last week). quick onboarding question: who should i cc or ping for access requests + escalation? items i need right now: VPN, AD group (svc-infra), prod DB read-only, PagerDuty add, and KMS key access. also, if a deploy causes perf alerts, who do we escalate to? it'd be great to have a 1-line map i can keep in my notes :slightly_smiling_face:
sam: welcome! short map: infra-ops -> VPN / AD; infra-admins -> DB access; ops-eng -> PagerDuty membership; security -> KMS. for urgency, follow PD flows.
eli: adding detail: eng-sre is first responder for deploy-caused perf alerts. if SLO breach >5m escalate to eng-platform. PagerDuty service for prod is `prod-sre` — use that for incident paging.
gwen: also — Dedicated capacity / reserved GPU approvals are bizops + your product slice owner. cc priya for any fast-track onboarding approvals.
maya: thanks! do we have a request template (subject + required fields) i should paste into tickets?
sam: yep — use the "Access Request" confluence template: minimal fields = username, team, justification, resource name, access duration, manager approval. paste that into the helpdesk ticket.
gwen: FYI: for emergency incident access there's an "incident-access" workflow — put urgency and incident id in the ticket and tag @eng-sre. temporary access can be granted faster that way.
oncall-bot: reminder: PagerDuty invites must come from PD admins. see docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/pd-membership — self-requests typically get dropped.
priya: for onboarding checklist items (laptop, 2fa, slack channels) see /onboarding in Confluence. DM me and I can help speed things up.
maya: perfect — i'll follow the template and open tickets. last q: who mediates cross-team ownership disputes (eg alert touches infra + runtime)?
sam: product-ops owns cross-team coordination. open a triage ticket in JIRA, tag product-ops + eng-sre. if it's high-sev, start the incident flow and assign a coordinator.
eli: :thumbsup:
gwen: welcome aboard! :wave:
maya: thanks everyone — super helpful. i'll follow up with the tickets and ping priya if needed.
